title: Admin Search Vendors - Accessibility Test Plan (WCAG 2.1 AA)
overview: Comprehensive accessibility test plan for Admin Search Vendors feature covering WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for search input, dynamic results, no-results state, partial match behavior, cross-tab search, and screen reader announcements.

testCases.title: Search input has proper label
testCases.wcagCriterion: 4.1.2 Name Role Value, 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
testCases.preconditions: Admin is logged in and on Vendor Management page
steps: 1. Locate search input field
2. Verify visible label present (e.g., 'Search vendors')
3. Verify label programmatically associated (for/id or aria-labelledby)
4. Verify placeholder is supplementary, not sole label
5. Verify role='searchbox' or type='search' present
6. Use screen reader to verify label announced on focus
expectedResults: Search input has visible label or aria-label
Screen reader announces purpose on focus

testCases.title: Search input keyboard accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Management page
steps: 1. Tab to search input
2. Verify focus indicator visible with 3:1 contrast
3. Type search query using keyboard
4. Verify text appears in input
5. Press Enter to submit (if submit-on-enter supported)
6. Verify Tab moves focus to next element
expectedResults: No keyboard trap in search field

testCases.title: Search results update announced dynamically
testCases.preconditions: Admin types a search query that returns results
steps: 1. Type vendor name in search input (min 3 characters)
2. Wait for results to update dynamically
3. Verify aria-live region announces result count
4. Verify announcement format: 'X vendors found' or similar
5. Verify announcement does not interrupt current reading
6. Verify focus remains in search input during update
expectedResults: Results update dynamically as user types
Announcement does not interrupt screen reader

testCases.title: No results message accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin types a query with no matching vendors
steps: 1. Type a query that returns no results (e.g., 'xyznonexistent')
2. Verify 'No vendors found' message displayed
3. Verify message has role='status' or aria-live
4. Verify message announced by screen reader
5. Verify message has 4.5:1 contrast
6. Verify message provides guidance (e.g., 'Try different keywords')

testCases.title: Partial match results accessible (min 3 characters)
testCases.preconditions: Admin types partial vendor name (3+ characters)
steps: 1. Type 2 characters — verify no search triggered
2. Type 3rd character — verify search triggers
3. Verify partial matches displayed
4. Verify result count announced
5. Verify minimum character requirement communicated to user
expectedResults: Minimum character requirement indicated (placeholder or help text)

testCases.title: Search works across all tabs
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Management page with multiple status tabs
steps: 1. Select 'Active Partners' tab
2. Type search query
3. Verify results filter within current tab
4. Switch to 'Pending Approval' tab
5. Verify search persists or clears (document behavior)
6. Verify result count updates and is announced
expectedResults: Result count announced on tab switch

testCases.title: Search clear button accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin has typed a search query
steps: 1. Type a search query
2. Verify clear button appears (X icon or 'Clear')
3. Verify clear button has accessible name ('Clear search' or similar)
4. Tab to clear button — verify focus indicator visible
5. Press Enter/Space to clear
6. Verify search input cleared and results reset
7. Verify reset announced via aria-live
expectedResults: Clear button visible when text entered

testCases.title: Search results list semantic structure
testCases.preconditions: Admin has performed a search with results
steps: 1. Perform search that returns results
2. Verify results in semantic list structure
3. Verify each result has proper structure (name, location, contact)
4. Use screen reader to verify list announced with count
5. Verify results keyboard navigable
expectedResults: Results in semantic list (<ul> or role='list')
Screen reader announces list with item count

testCases.title: Search handles special characters gracefully
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Management page
steps: 1. Type special characters in search (e.g., '<script>', '&', '"')
2. Verify no error or crash occurs
3. Verify results display normally (empty or matching)
4. Verify no XSS or injection in displayed results
5. If error shown, verify error is accessible (role='alert')

testCases.title: Long search query handled gracefully
testCases.componentElement: Search input with very long query
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Management page
steps: 1. Type a very long search query (100+ characters)
2. Verify input handles text without breaking layout
3. Verify no horizontal scrolling on page
4. Verify search still functions
5. If character limit exists, verify limit communicated accessibly
expectedResults: Long query handled without layout break

testCases.title: Search loading state accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin types a search query triggering data fetch
steps: 1. Type search query
2. If loading indicator appears, verify it has accessible name
3. Verify loading state announced via aria-live
4. Verify loading does not trap keyboard focus
5. Verify completion announced
expectedResults: Loading indicator has accessible name if visible
Loading state announced to screen readers
Keyboard focus not trapped during loading

testCases.title: Text contrast meets WCAG AA
testCases.componentElement: All text elements related to search
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Management page with search results
steps: 1. Measure search input text contrast
2. Measure placeholder text contrast
3. Measure result text contrast
4. Measure no-results message contrast
5. Measure search label contrast

testCases.title: Search usable at 200% zoom
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Management page
steps: 1. Set browser zoom to 200%
2. Verify search input visible and usable
3. Type search query — verify results display
4. Verify no horizontal scrolling
5. Verify no text truncation in results

testCases.title: Search accessible on mobile viewport
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Management page on mobile
steps: 1. Set viewport to mobile (375x667)
2. Verify search input visible and usable
3. Verify touch target at least 44x44px
4. Type query and verify results display
5. Verify no horizontal scrolling

testCases.title: Focus indicators visible on search elements
testCases.componentElement: Search input and clear button focus indicators
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Management page
steps: 1. Tab to search input — verify focus indicator
2. Tab to clear button (if visible) — verify focus indicator
3. Measure focus indicator contrast (3:1 minimum)
4. Verify focus not obscured
expectedResults: Focus indicator visible on search input
Focus indicator visible on clear button

testCases.title: NVDA screen reader compatibility
testCases.preconditions: NVDA enabled, Admin on Vendor Management page
steps: 1. Navigate to search input with NVDA
2. Verify input label announced
3. Type search query
4. Verify results announced
5. Navigate results with screen reader
6. Clear search and verify announcement

testCases.title: JAWS screen reader compatibility
testCases.preconditions: JAWS enabled, Admin on Vendor Management page
steps: 1. Navigate to search input with JAWS
2. Enter forms mode
3. Type search query
4. Verify results announced
5. Exit forms mode and navigate results
6. Verify all interactions accessible
expectedResults: Search input accessible in forms mode

testCases.title: No keyboard traps in search flow
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Management page
steps: 1. Tab to search input
2. Type query
3. Tab away from search input
4. Verify focus moves to next element
5. Shift+Tab back to search
6. Verify no keyboard trap
expectedResults: No keyboard trap in search input
Tab moves focus away from search
Focus can reach all page elements
